text:
GruntWorx should inherit the shared reliability mechanisms, while defining its own API limits, status mappings and entity rules. The Instead code provides five concrete lessons.

1. **Rate limits must reflect the vendor’s actual budget boundaries.** Instead throttles each API group **per connection**, then applies an application-wide limit. Ordering matters: a job blocked by its connection’s limit must not consume the app budget. Limits also differ by environment: development has `docs: 5/min` and `500/min` app-wide; production has `docs: 60/min` and `3,000/min` app-wide. GruntWorx needs independently verified settings. Honor `Retry-After` as seconds or an HTTP date. The shared worker allows 10 retries, but throttling resets the retry count, so this is **not a wall-clock deadline**. [Throttle](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/config/initializers/sidekiq.rb:102), [production limits](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/config/settings/production.yml:187), [retry policy](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/workers/tax_preparation/tax_automations/operation_worker.rb:10).

2. **Webhooks need bounded reconciliation.** The sweep selects uploaded documents still `sent` after **1 hour**, or `processing` after **12 hours**, within a **2-day** window; providers can override these thresholds. Instead groups candidates by entity/year, reads paginated folder listings, then individually checks documents absent from every page. An individual document’s `404` becomes `archived`; a missing/forbidden folder is skipped. Page workers make one attempt and rely on the next sweep. GruntWorx should implement equivalent readback and explicitly accept or change the two-day cutoff: older sends remain untouched. Webhooks and reconciliation should share the same status-folding service to handle duplicates and late reports consistently. [Candidate windows](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/queries/tax_preparation/tax_automations/documents/reconcile_candidates_query.rb:8), [pagination](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/workers/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/documents/reconcile_statuses_worker.rb:3), [individual fallback](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/documents/reconcile_status.rb:36).

3. **Keep a small, shared failure vocabulary.** Current reasons are `unexpected`, `no_active_connection`, `network_error`, `unauthorized`, `api_error`, `exceeded`, `forbidden`, and `encrypted`. Instead maps `password_required` to `encrypted`; an unknown processing refusal becomes `error` with no reason. GruntWorx should translate its vocabulary at the adapter boundary. Distinguish temporary throttling from exhausted plan quota, and authorization failures from entity-access failures: they require different recovery actions. [Vocabulary](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/models/tax_preparation/tax_automations/document.rb:11), [Instead mapping](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/documents/apply_processing_status.rb:10).

4. **Signed-URL cassettes need both sanitization and deterministic time.** The recording hook scrubs S3 policy/credential/signature fields and OAuth client secrets from JSON, multipart and form bodies. Bearer/access/refresh-token scrubbing is currently **Instead-host-specific**, so GruntWorx must extend that coverage. Tagged replay freezes time at the cassette’s first `recorded_at`, keeping recorded upload expirations meaningful; a fresh recording uses real time. Preserve both behaviors. [Recording hook](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/spec/spec_helper.rb:179), [replay clock](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/spec/support/vcr_fixed_time.rb:3).

5. **Entity matching should prefer ambiguity over a wrong link.** Instead considers only active, unlinked entities in the same firm and return type, and links only a unique match. It normalizes punctuation, whitespace and case; businesses also normalize legal-form spellings and `&`/`and`. Personal matching permits account-name fallback only for a sole contact, and swapped first/last names only after no direct match. Multiple matches remain unlinked and outcomes are measured. GruntWorx should inherit these safeguards, with matching keys adapted to its actual identity model. [Matching implementation](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/clients/link_entity_by_name.rb:13).

These are conclusions from the existing Instead implementation, not verified GruntWorx capabilities. No files were edited.
